enjoyment_reasons: Semantic kinds and chart/diagram contracts worked first time and looked good (org, option matrix, regions, funnel, gantt, quotes)
Named patterns were a guessing game in the default profile: no shape, no example, errors one field at a time
validate passed things render refused; a gate passed a slide titled 'Replace with the action title...'
Recommender put the wrong visual first for swimlane, vendor matrix and Gantt
No current picture of a layout before authoring; shipped previews are stale
--tools all fixes discovery (show_pattern, validate_pattern, single-slide render) but costs 335 KB of tool definitions

findings.title: Named-pattern recommendations carry no data shape, example or next step; default profile has no tool that does
findings.what_happened: recommend_visual gives chart/diagram/compose candidates a data_contract and a runnable next_tool_call, but named_pattern candidates (the #1 answer for 9 of 14 intents) carry only name/capacity. The default profile has no show_pattern/list_patterns; raw_json2pptx's item_schema is `slide: object`; get_started says the 22 non-kind patterns are listed in SKILL.md, which an MCP-only agent cannot read. I had to guess `values` for card-grid, before-after, journey-maturity-model, value-chain, swimlane, roadmap-phased.
evidence: default n=5..18: named_pattern candidates have no data_contract/next_tool_call; diagram/chart ones do
default n=19: raw_json2pptx item_schema slide = {type: object}
default n=3: 'for one of the other 22 ... SKILL.md lists them all'
all n=15: identical response, still no pointer to show_pattern
findings.expected: Every candidate, whatever its category, tells me its exact data shape, limits and a runnable example.
findings.suggestion: Give named_pattern candidates the same data_contract + next_tool_call (example_values from show_pattern wrapped in a raw_json2pptx slide), name the DeckSpec kind that reaches the pattern when one exists (strategy-house -> pillars, table-highlight -> option_matrix, quote-cluster -> quote), and put show_pattern in the default profile.

findings.title: validate_deck_spec says 'no issues' for raw pattern/diagram payloads that render_deck_spec then refuses
findings.what_happened: Two specs validated clean and then failed at render with a hard error about an unknown key. Validation is advertised as the gate before render.
evidence: default n=39: ok=true (only TITLE_NOT_ACTION info) -> n=64: 'journey-maturity-model: unknown field "current" at values.current is dropped'
default n=41: ok=true 'no issues' -> n=66: 'value_chain: data.primary[2].highlight: unknown key "highlight"'
findings.expected: validate_deck_spec reports everything render_deck_spec will refuse.
findings.suggestion: Run the same pattern-values and diagram-data key checks in validate_deck_spec for raw_json2pptx slides.

findings.title: Raw pattern errors in the default profile leak the shape one field per round, with a path that is wrong
findings.what_happened: card-grid needed 4 validate rounds: 'cells must contain exactly 5 items, got 0' at path slides[0].slide.pattern.cells; moving cells to that path gave 'unknown field "cells"'; cells actually lives in pattern.values; then 'cells[0].header is required' (my `title` key was never flagged). A swimlane with `teams` instead of `lanes` got 'lanes must contain at least 2 items, got 0' with no mention of the unknown key. The all-profile validate_pattern answers the same mistakes in one step with did_you_mean.
evidence: default n=98: 'swimlane: lanes must contain at least 2 items, got 0' path slides[0].slide.pattern.lanes
all n=25: 'unknown field "cards" at values.cards ... did you mean "cells"?' + next_tool_call show_pattern
findings.expected: First error names the unknown key, the correct path (pattern.values.cells) and the full expected item shape.
findings.suggestion: Route raw-slide pattern validation through the validate_pattern checker; fix the path to include `.values`; attach the values schema (or example_values) to any shape error.

findings.title: decision kind refuses 5 options because the engine's own RECOMMENDED badge shrinks to 11.8pt
findings.what_happened: Schema says 3-6 options render as numbered boxes and requires exactly one recommended:true. With 5 options, even 'Option 1'/'Short detail.', validation fails TEXT_BELOW_READABLE_MIN and tells me to 'shorten the text'; the offending paragraph_text is 'RECOMMENDED', which I did not write. Suggested patch is to fall back to layout 'content' (bullets). 4 options pass. Rendered result is numbered rows, not boxes/cards. card-grid with 5 columns and a recommended cell draws the same badge fine.
evidence: default n=47 (5 minimal options) error; n=48 (4 options) ok
findings.expected: The documented 3-6 range works, and an error never asks me to shorten text the engine generated.
findings.suggestion: Size the badge so it fits at 5-6 options (or drop to 'Rec.'/accent fill only), and exclude engine-authored labels from shorten-the-text findings.

findings.title: recommend_visual ranks the wrong visual first for several plain intents
findings.what_happened: swimlane across three teams -> team-bios 0.92 first, swimlane 4th at 0.90 (keyword 'teams'). Three vendors x five criteria with a recommendation -> bar chart 0.85 first, table-highlight (the one that renders exactly this) last at 0.80. Gantt for 6 workstreams -> roadmap-phased 0.97 above gantt 0.92; roadmap-phased renders a grid of text cells, not bars on a time axis. Maturity model -> funnel chart 0.92 as #3. Value chain -> stat-hero 0.90. Screenshot intent -> list not sorted by score (0.76 listed before 0.88).
findings.expected: The visual whose name the intent literally contains (swimlane, Gantt) or whose use_when matches (options x criteria + recommendation) ranks first.
findings.suggestion: Boost exact name/alias hits over incidental keywords; use item_count/criteria counts parsed from the intent; sort candidates by score; drop candidates that share no concept with the intent.

findings.title: Same-slide chart+KPI+timeline: recommender swaps the requested line chart for a bar and never mentions the `regions` kind
findings.what_happened: Intent said 'revenue line chart ... 3-milestone timeline'. Top candidate was compose:chart:bar+diagram:timeline+stat-hero with a range-bar timeline diagram (3 phases + 1 milestone). The DeckSpec `regions` kind (found only by reading list_slide_kinds) does exactly the brief in one attempt with a line chart and a 3-stop milestone line. Two unconnected ways to do the same slide, and the recommender picked the weaker one.
evidence: default n=35/n=62 regions valid first time
findings.expected: The recommender honours the chart type in the intent and offers the semantic kind first.
findings.suggestion: Parse the chart type from the intent; emit a `regions` next_tool_call when the views map to region kinds, and keep compose for what regions cannot express.

findings.title: Placeholder copy from next_tool_call passes the deterministic gate
findings.what_happened: Rendering recommend_visual's args_template verbatim produced a slide titled 'Replace with the action title this bar + stat-hero + timeline composition supports' with deterministic_ready=true and no diagnostics, although the server instructions say never to ship placeholder content.
evidence: default n=96: deterministic_ready true, zero diagnostics
findings.expected: Template strings the product itself emits are detected as placeholder content.
findings.suggestion: Flag 'Replace with ...' titles/alt text and the 'Illustrative sample data; replace with the real source' line with the existing exemplar_content blocking reason.

findings.title: No trustworthy picture before authoring: previews are sparse, server-local file paths, and out of date
findings.what_happened: Of the visuals I ended up using for the 14 intents, only 3 had a preview_png_path (card-grid, before-after, swimlane); kinds, charts, diagrams, compose and patterns such as strategy-house, journey-maturity-model, value-chain, quote-cluster, table-highlight had none. The path is a file inside the server's repo checkout, not an MCP image block, so a remote client cannot open it. The pictures do not match the render: card-grid preview is solid blue 3x2 cards filling the slide, render is light-grey cards with an accent rule in the top half; before-after preview has solid blue headers and a large chevron; swimlane preview has blue actor blocks and no arrows; matrix-2x2 preview shows a blue top banner and a stray stub line, render has arrow axes. list_slide_kinds and show_pattern carry no picture at all. The working preview in the all profile is show_pattern.example_values -> render_slide_image_from_json (2 calls, ~55 KB, 1.1 s), which nothing points to.
evidence: default n=5..18: preview_png_path present on 15 of 26 distinct named-pattern candidates
all n=16..18: render_slide_image_from_json of example_values, 48-64 KB, 1.1-1.9 s
findings.expected: One call shows me a current thumbnail of any kind/pattern/diagram on my template, as image content.
findings.suggestion: Add a preview tool (or preview:true on list_slide_kinds / show_pattern / recommend_visual candidates) that renders the catalogued example on the chosen template and returns an image block; regenerate or drop the stale pre-rendered PNGs.

findings.title: house_diagram `floors` is advertised but undocumented, and silently drops content either way
findings.what_happened: data_contract lists floors as an optional key but the description never says what it takes. floors as strings: the floor vanished with no finding. floors as [{label}]: the two floors drew but all four `sections` (pillars) vanished. Both renders reported deterministic_ready=true with only a sparse_layout info.
evidence: default n=5: optional_keys [roof, sections, floors, foundation, footnote], description omits floors
findings.expected: An advertised key is described, and content that will not be drawn is reported.
findings.suggestion: Document floors (shape, and that it is mutually exclusive with sections) or support both; emit a finding when authored content is not drawn.

findings.title: Screenshot with callouts pointing at parts of it cannot be expressed
findings.what_happened: Default profile: only image_case / image-text-split (picture beside bullets). All profile: get_shape_catalog lists callout geometries, but shape_grid is a non-overlapping grid, get_input_schema gives shape_grid fields with no descriptions, and my wedgeRectCallout cells rendered as bare text with no fill, outline or pointer, with no warning.
evidence: all n=20, n=21 (GridCellInput/ShapeSpecInput properties have empty descriptions), n=22-23
findings.expected: An annotated-image visual: image plus N callouts each anchored at an x/y on the image.
findings.suggestion: Add an `annotations: [{x_pct, y_pct, label}]` field to image-text-split / image_case (numbered markers on the image keyed to the bullets is enough); have recommend_visual say 'unsupported: callouts on image' as it does for Sankey.

findings.title: Shape text starting '2.' is rendered as '1.'
findings.what_happened: A shape_grid cell with text '2. Enabler bar: funded first' rendered as '1. Enabler bar: funded first'. No finding. The slide now has two callouts both numbered 1.
findings.expected: Authored text is rendered verbatim.
findings.suggestion: Do not convert a single 'N. text' line into an auto-numbered list, or preserve its start number.

findings.title: The same visual has up to three names and three data shapes
findings.what_happened: 2x2: kind matrix_2x2 (x_axis, quadrants clockwise from top-left), pattern matrix-2x2 (x_axis_label, quadrants [TL,TR,BL,BR]), diagram matrix_2x2 (x_axis_label, quadrants [{position,title,items}] or points). Only the diagram plots items, which neither the kind summary nor the recommender rationale says. Also value-chain/value_chain, process-flow/process_flow, org/org_chart; quote {role} vs quote-cluster {title}; option_matrix recommended/decisive_criterion vs table-highlight highlight_row/highlight_col. Chart types are 'bar'/'line'/'funnel' in recommend_visual and get_data_format_hints but 'bar_chart'/'line_chart' in list_slide_kinds; a chart sits under chart_value on a content slide but under a `diagram` key inside compose.
evidence: default n=14: matrix-2x2 (pattern) and matrix_2x2 (diagram) both 0.95
default n=21: matrix_2x2 kind 'clockwise from the top left'
all n=10: pattern quadrants 'Positional: [top_left, top_right, bottom_left, bottom_right]'
default n=9 compose segment {diagram:{type:'bar'}} vs n=7 chart_value
findings.expected: One name per visual, one field vocabulary, and a stated difference when two renderers exist.
findings.suggestion: Publish a kind <-> pattern <-> diagram map with 'differs in' notes (e.g. 'diagram plots points; pattern holds text per quadrant'); align quadrant order and axis field names; accept one chart-type vocabulary everywhere.

findings.title: Default-profile responses point at tools and files the agent cannot reach
findings.what_happened: get_started lists get_capabilities, validate_input, preview_presentation_plan, generate_presentation, inspect_slide_images and make_deck; chart type descriptions say 'see get_chart_capabilities' (not in either profile); item_schema descriptions cite explain_deck_spec; guidance cites SKILL.md, QUALITY.md and WORKFLOW.md.
evidence: default n=21: 'Chart type, e.g. bar_chart, line_chart, pie_chart (see get_chart_capabilities)'
all tools/list: no get_chart_capabilities among 49 tools
findings.expected: Every tool or document a response names is callable/readable in the profile that returned it.
findings.suggestion: Filter references by the active profile; replace doc references with a tool call or inline text; list valid chart types in the schema enum.

findings.title: --tools all costs 335 KB of tool definitions before the first call
findings.what_happened: tools/list is 41.6 KB for 12 tools in the default profile and 335 KB for 49 tools with --tools all (179 KB of it outputSchema, 107 KB inputSchema; validate_deck_spec alone is 35 KB). The four tools that fixed my discovery problems (list_patterns, show_pattern, validate_pattern, render_slide_image_from_json) are a small fraction of that.
findings.expected: The pattern catalogue is reachable without paying for 37 extra tools.
findings.suggestion: Move show_pattern (+ list_patterns, validate_pattern, single-slide render) into the default profile or add a 'discovery' profile; drop or shrink outputSchema.

findings.title: Patterns leave the bottom 40-50% of the slide empty and the gate scores them 100
findings.what_happened: card-grid 5x1, before-after, value-chain and strategy-house all hang in the top half. The fix (pattern.vertical_align: 'stretch') is documented only in show_pattern, which the default profile lacks. Scores were 100 with no finding.
evidence: all n=9: vertical_align 'auto ... hangs a block filling under 60% of the area from its top'
findings.expected: A one-row pattern fills or centres in the content area by default, or a finding tells me how to make it.
findings.suggestion: Emit a sparse-slide finding naming vertical_align when a pattern fills under ~60% with nothing beneath it; expose vertical_align on the semantic kinds.

findings.title: Swimlane arrows follow column order, and the idiom that makes them right is only in show_pattern's example
findings.what_happened: My first swimlane (3 steps per lane, aligned by column) validated and rendered with arrows running down each column then jumping to the next ('Fix bug' -> 'Approve fix'), which is not the process. The flow cannot be stated. show_pattern's example uses one step per column with empty strings elsewhere, which draws the correct staircase; I only saw that in the all profile.
evidence: all n=9: example_values lanes with '' placeholders
findings.expected: Either I state the step order, or the schema says 'one step per column; arrows connect columns left to right'.
findings.suggestion: Say so in the steps description and the recommender rationale; warn when two lanes have a step in the same column.

findings.title: An info-severity finding blocks the gate at render after validate said ok
findings.what_happened: validate_deck_spec: ok=true, '1 warning, 1 info' (NO_EXECUTIVE_SUMMARY is the info). render_deck_spec on the same spec: deterministic_ready=false, 'quality gate: deck storyline incomplete (require_storyline: NO_EXECUTIVE_SUMMARY)'.
findings.expected: Severity predicts whether something blocks.
findings.suggestion: Report gate-blocking findings as errors (or mark them blocking:true) in validate_deck_spec.

findings.title: Responses repeat boilerplate; discovery of 14 slides cost ~230 KB of JSON before any picture
findings.what_happened: Default profile non-image payload was 369 KB over 76 calls: tools/list 41.6 KB, get_started 12.2 KB, list_slide_kinds 22.9 KB, 14 recommend_visual calls 71.9 KB (each candidate repeats template_hash, placement, template_support, layout_preview_png_path), item_schema for 13 kinds 59 KB (each kind repeats the same layout/pattern/source/takeaway descriptions and all alias fields), every single-slide render 3-3.8 KB (quality_gate criteria block each time). disambiguating_questions always asks 'How many items will this slide contain?' even for 'five option cards' and 'org chart of 7 people'.
evidence: default n=6 and n=8: disambiguating_questions despite stated counts
default n=23: 3476 B for a 1-slide render
findings.expected: Payloads proportional to what is new.
findings.suggestion: Hoist per-response constants; a compact item_schema projection (fields + limits only); omit quality_gate.criteria unless it failed; skip disambiguating questions the intent already answers.

findings.title: Small catalogue and doc slips
findings.what_happened: list_patterns returns 50 of 51 patterns by default, so one pattern needs a second page. show_pattern before-after describes `before` as 'Right column (future/after state)'. card-grid style default is documented as 'filled (default solid accent cards)' but the default render is light-grey cards. The pillars foundation type error is reported twice (warning and error) for one mistake. The gantt diagram reorders tasks by start date rather than keeping authored order.
evidence: all n=3: total_count 51, page_size 50, next_cursor present
default n=22: input-1 warning + input-2 error on slides[0].foundation
findings.expected: Catalogue fits one page; descriptions match behaviour.
findings.suggestion: Default page_size >= catalogue size; fix the two descriptions; dedupe the type finding; keep authored task order (or document the sort).

findings.title: Strategy house cannot hold two enabling layers
findings.what_happened: pillars.foundation / strategy-house.foundation is a single string (max 140 chars). An array is rejected. The only native result is one grey bar with both enablers joined by a separator.
evidence: default n=22: 'pillars foundation must be a string'
findings.expected: foundation accepts 1-2 rows.
findings.suggestion: Allow foundation: string | string[] (max 2-3 rows).

delights.title: Chart and diagram candidates come with a data_contract and a next_tool_call that runs verbatim
evidence: default n=7 funnel, n=15 gantt, n=14 matrix_2x2 points contract ('0-100 scale ... NOT 0-1')
default n=96: compose args_template rendered unchanged

delights.title: Semantic kinds for org, 8 quotes, option matrix, funnel+insights and regions were valid on the first attempt and looked right
`regions` kind: chart + stat + timeline in one slide from ~15 lines
Render-time unknown-key errors name the key, why it matters and the accepted keys
evidence: default n=66: 'expected keys: description, items, label, name, title'

delights.title: show_pattern is an authoritative contract: closed schema, min/max items, per-count character budgets, example_values
evidence: all n=9 swimlane: 'Approximate readable chars per step by step columns x lanes'

delights.title: validate_pattern answers a wrong key with did_you_mean, a patch and a pointer to show_pattern
Single-slide render loop is fast and returns a real image
Capacity strings on candidates ('3-8', 'objective + 3-5 pillars + foundation') and limits in kind summaries let me check item counts before authoring
evidence: default n=5, n=16; default n=4 summaries
